flags.message: Forward-cell timing relative to the conference order lists: all three candidates ran on 2026-10-04, after the 2026-10-01 grant list from the 2026-09-28 conference had issued and one day before the 2026-10-05 denial. A petition absent from the grant list is, at that point, almost certainly a denial or a relist, so a forward cell placed in that window carries a strong legitimate signal about its own disposition that the band baseline does not condition on. claude-baseline disclosed seeing other 2026-10-01 grants in a corpus query and did not look for this case; none of the three used the signal. Not leakage under the mode rules, but worth weighing in how forward distribution-moment cells are scheduled against the Court's order-list calendar.

The blinded prediction.json stages big_case_score and big_case_rationale alongside the fields the evaluator must read first, so the instruction to form the big_case read before seeing the predictor's cannot be honoured structurally. My read (0.42) was formed from the record and outcome and I did not use the predictors' values, but the independence is procedural rather than enforced.
